_comment: Table-driven GUCSet.Validate() cases for pair 1 (pgcommon <-> pgcommon-py). Both go-probe's gucset-check and python-probe's gucset-check load this file, run every case through their own language's GUCSet.Validate(), and must agree on accept/reject and on which error fired for every case. expected_error values: null (valid), "inconsistent" (ErrInconsistentGUCSet/InconsistentGUCSetError), "roles_without_tenant" (ErrTenantRolesWithoutTenant/TenantRolesWithoutTenantError), "empty_role" (ErrEmptyTenantRole/EmptyTenantRoleError), "invalid_role" (ErrInvalidTenantRole/InvalidTenantRoleError), "invalid_value" (ErrInvalidGUCValue/InvalidGUCValueError). Both libraries check in this order, first failure wins: user_id without tenant_id; tenant_roles without tenant_id; user_id/tenant_id value validity; then per role, in list order: empty, comma, value validity. Invalid values are spelled with a NUL (\u0000) only: a lone surrogate or invalid UTF-8 decodes differently in Go (U+FFFD) and Python (a lone surrogate str), so it would not test the same input.

cases.name: tenant_only_no_user_is_valid
cases.note: Background jobs / system-scoped operations: tenant context without a specific user is allowed. Only user-without-tenant is rejected.

cases.name: user_without_tenant_with_roles_is_still_inconsistent
cases.note: Precedence: user-without-tenant is checked before roles-without-tenant, so this is inconsistent, not roles_without_tenant.

cases.name: roles_without_tenant_is_rejected
cases.note: Roles are only meaningful within a tenant scope.

cases.name: roles_without_tenant_wins_over_empty_role
cases.note: Precedence: the missing tenant is reported before any per-role check.

cases.name: nul_only_tenant_id_is_invalid_value
cases.note: A NUL-only tenant_id is non-empty, so it scopes the GUCSet but is not a valid value.

cases.name: nul_in_user_id_without_tenant_is_inconsistent
cases.note: Precedence: user-without-tenant is checked before value validity.

cases.name: nul_in_tenant_id_wins_over_empty_role
cases.note: Precedence: user_id/tenant_id values are checked before any role.

cases.name: empty_role_before_later_nul_role
cases.note: Roles are checked in list order; the first failing role decides.

cases.name: comma_checked_before_nul_in_the_same_role
cases.note: Within one role: empty, then comma, then value validity.

cases.name: non_ascii_utf8_values_are_valid
cases.note: Valid non-ASCII UTF-8 is accepted by both.
